description: Sentence-initial inferential connective synonyms. Uniform sampling among eligible members of the closed set.

context_requirements.position: start of sentence (preceded by sentence-final punctuation + whitespace, or start of a reasoning step/line), OR immediately after a clause-initial comma
context_requirements.must_be_followed_by: a comma or a complete clause (subject-verb detectable within the next 12 tokens)

exclusions: 'so that' constructions (purpose clauses) — check next non-space token != 'that'
comparative/degree 'so' — exclude when followed by adjective/adverb + 'that' or by 'much'/'many'/'few'/'little'
inside code blocks (fenced or inline backticks)
when the span overlaps a site matched by another rule (overlap resolution: lowest rule_id wins, other rule skips)
span_note: Tokenizer may split members into different token counts. Score full forced span per SPEC section 2; no length normalization.

registered_predictions.fable_depth_interaction: zero on base/light-instruct; positive post outcome-filtered training; highest-priority rule for constant brittleness penalty
